targets.status: planned; no EFI loader or bootable image yet

integrations: Kloz is the candidate caller-owned memory/resource substrate through a narrow adapter
CO is the candidate deterministic component lifecycle runtime through a narrow adapter
SaintSI is the candidate bounded health observer; CRC-32 is not authentication
ReaperCripple provides BSP and board-qualification patterns, not a generic bootloader
SAMBU provides language/compiler architecture and developer tooling; its Python runtime is not a kernel dependency
ToolNG contributes local diagnostics and evidence UX patterns; Windows device APIs remain host-only
Klipot contributes registry, schema and dependency-planning contracts
NUNLauncher is the Android Home shell and is not the UEFI loader
safety: No native extension executes during discovery or validation
Firmware services are not used after successful ExitBootServices
Only mapped and bounded memory-map entries are validated
CRC-32 is not a signature or authentication mechanism
No bootable or production hardware support is claimed before emulator and target evidence exists
